query: SELECT s.phase, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM idempotency i WHERE i.conversation_id=s.conversation_id AND i.execution_status IN ('queued','sending')) AS "work_waiting!", EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM templates t WHERE t.name=c.template AND 'desktop'=ANY(t.capabilities)) AS "desktop!" FROM sandbox_instances s JOIN conversations c ON c.id=s.conversation_id WHERE s.conversation_id=$1
